question: Can conditional standardized distribution shape improve carbon price probabilistic forecasts beyond scale-only and empirical distribution controls?
novelty: Necessity diagnostic using established modules, not a proposed novel algorithm. No claim of point-mean improvement.
data_exposure: The five development files were previously used; 2022 and 2023 are not untouched tests. EEX2024/2025 remain unopened for model use. Shanghai confirmation was previously exposed.
data_extension: New Shenzhen PLOS author workbook has only been checked mechanically; no new-source price file is supplied to this experiment.
validation_and_training: Own issued distribution chooses checkpoint by h1/5/20 raw CRPS / same-validation-cell fixedFHS CRPS. Training uses all20 raw-unit CRPS / fixed training-cell FHS CRPS. Author_rps arm uses original source score with same native units/denominators. Epoch0 eligible. Purge fullH20 from training into firstvalidation origin; all validation labels <yearstart. No year-internal parameter updates.
scale: EWMA(.94), initialized from first60 increments; sigma_t,h=sigma_t sqrt(h), first60 variance floor fixed. Each historical outcome is divided by its own origin scale.
finite_measure: 31 midpoint quantile atoms for every arm, gapfloor1e-4 on nondegenerate empirical quantiles. Exact probability-weighted CRPS uses V-statistic formula. This regularized finite approximation does not preserve an exact zero-return atom.
common_mean: Every issued finite measure is probability-centered at zero raw change. Common price mean=current price; MSE equals RW up to rounding. Zero drift is a modeling restriction, not a physical/no-arbitrage theorem.
shape_control: global_shape and conditional_shape have exact zero mean/unit variance; scale_only and shape_scale additionally use exp(tanh(head)) multiplier. Both conditional shape heads change positive FHS gaps by exp(2tanh(head)); common zero-initialized heads.
author_adapter: Unmodified GluonTS DeepNPTS MLP/distribution core d60556ca71167a3ec1ea807b491dd982d1de2112; current past20 input mapped into fixed FHS support slots, direct20 horizons, static h/20, shared p=.03/31+.97*p_author, weighted mean0/unitvar. Original score vs exact CRPS pair. Not author benchmark reproduction; scoring correction is established CRPS, not an original algorithm.
garch: normal and standardized t5 maximum likelihood; each one fixed start, training-price prefix only, zero mean; cumulative horizon variance analytic; normal/t5 shape for h>1 is approximation. GARCH-FHS reuses normal fit with2048 fixed-seed recursive innovation draws perorigin then projects into31 normalized atoms with analytic sigma. No additional fit.
primary_score: Equal mean across5 series and h1/5/20 of test-cell raw CRPS divided by same-cell fixedFHS CRPS. Lower is better. Seeds/overlapping origins/related EEX and EU are not IID repetitions.
gate_meaning: All gates required before considering further model invention for this fixed need. One percent is a resource gate, not a publication threshold. Failure ends the fixed experiment, no new hyperparameters.
later_stages: No D2/bootstrap/C under this protocol. Even a pass only motivates a separately defined new mechanism and independently frozen experiment; no publication or novelty certification.
failure_policy: Record all failed/incomplete jobs. No retries. Stop expansion on failure; genuine defects require explicit recorded revision, not silent source edits.
publication: Publish source/aggregate metrics/training traces/provenance. Keep per-origin prices, forecasts, residual paths and weights in local_only. No raw EEX data redistribution.
neural_batch_sampler: Dedicated torch.Generator(seed=17) for randperm, independent of model parameter initialization; shared batch orders for paired families.
